subject: Senior Backend (Remote) — relocation reimbursement cap & signing timeline
messages:
From: Grace Recruiting <offers@gracerecruit.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer for Aisha Njoroge — Senior Backend (remote)

Hi team,

Attached is the initial offer draft for Aisha Njoroge (Senior Backend Engineer, remote). Highlights:
- Base salary: $200,000
- Target OTE (base + bonus): 215k (10% annual bonus target)
- Signing bonus: $25,000 (one-time, conditional)
- Equity: 0.35% RSU grant, 4-year vesting, 1-year cliff
- Proposed start window: 60 days from acceptance (flexible)
- Relocation: candidate indicated potential relocation in year 1; draft currently includes reimbursement up to $10,000 and a 12-month clawback if they leave.

Two ask items before we send to the candidate:
1) Legal to confirm that the relocation "clawback" language aligns with our standard practice — can we shorten to 6 months for new hires at this level?
2) Compensation team: confirm comp band alignment and whether the signing bonus can be paid 50/50 (half on start, half after 6 months) if needed.

Please review the attached PDF and the comp-band spreadsheet. I can loop Aisha for any clarifying Qs after you confirm.

Attachments: 20261012-offer-draft-AishaNjoroge.pdf (PDF), comp-band-reference-2026-Q4.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Grace Patel
Offer Ops | Grace Recruiting
offers@gracerecruit.com

--

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Grace Recruiting <offers@gracerecruit.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Aisha Njoroge — Senior Backend (remote)

Thanks Grace — quick internal notes before we ask Aisha to sign: 
- Compensation: 200k base is within the band but let's confirm the band ceiling; please attach band name so comp team can stamp.
- Signing bonus: I'm open to 50/50 payout, however prefer the second tranche at 3 months (not 6) to reduce retention uncertainty. Any objections?
- Relocation/clawback: prefer a 6-month clawback with pro-rated repayment if they leave before 6 months (standard). Also add a clause that reimbursement applies only if move is >50 miles from remote location.
- Start window: Aisha asked about a ~90 day window depending on visa/timing; I think we should offer 60-90 days flexible and allow the hiring manager to approve an exception.

Laura — could you propose a redline for the relocation paragraph and short probation language (90-day performance check) we can include?

If legal approves, I’m happy to give Grace the greenlight to send.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Director, Backend Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft offer for Aisha Njoroge — Senior Backend (remote)

Hi all,

I reviewed the draft and made targeted redlines. Key changes (high-level):
- Relocation reimbursement: change to a reimbursement cap of $10,000 with a 6-month pro-rated repayment schedule if employment terminates voluntarily within 6 months. Added the >50-mile requirement.
- Clawback mechanics: if repayment is triggered, amount is pro-rated by days employed (e.g., leaving at day 90 of 180 months == 50% repayment). Updated language for clarity.
- Probation / performance check: added a 90-day "initial performance review" paragraph — not a separate probationary employment term, but a review to confirm role expectations.
- Signing bonus payout: recommended 50/50 split with second tranche at 3 months (to align with Dev's ask). Added a conditional repayment if they leave within 3 months of receiving the second tranche.
- IP & confidentiality: tightened language to use our standard employee IP paragraph (attached).

I attached a marked-up offer PDF and included an alternate clean copy ready for signature if you want to send it today.

Attachments: 20261013-offer-draft-AishaNjoroge-redlines.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Employment
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Offer for Senior Backend — couple clarifying Qs

Hi Grace (and Dev),

Thanks for sending the draft and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions before I sign: 
1) Start date flexibility — I may need up to ~75 days for relocation and final notice; will a 90-day window be acceptable?
2) Signing bonus timing — if the second half is at 3 months, will that be paid on the next regular payroll after 90 days or via separate check?
3) Relocation reimbursement — happy to accept a cap; can we get clarity on what receipts are required and whether temporary housing counts?

Also tagging that I am still finalizing a minor landlord obligation that might shift exact move dates by a week. I hope the team can be flexible. Happy to sign as soon as the clawback timing and payment schedule are clarified.

Regards,
Aisha Njoroge
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Final: approve redlines and send to candidate

Laura / Grace — thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed Laura's redlines and approve the language below: 
- Relocation reimbursement cap: $10,000; repayment pro-rated over 6 months; >50-mile trigger.
- Signing bonus: $25,000 split 50/50, second tranche at 3 months; HR will process payment on the first payroll after the 3-month anniversary.
- Start window: offer 60-day standard, with an explicit optional exception up to 90 days requiring hiring manager approval (Dev/People ops OK to approve).
- Initial performance review: 90-day check-in included for expectations alignment (not a probationary termination clause).

Grace — please send the revised clean offer (use Laura's clean copy) to Aisha and include a short cover email that explains the payment timing for the sign-on bonus and the receipts policy for relocation (receipts + invoices; temporary housing eligible up to 30 days). Also please cc me on the send.

Once Aisha signs, can HR add a comment to the offer in Workday with the 90-day review reminder and the relocation details? Laura — if you're good with the final IP paragraph, we can proceed.

Thanks,
Dev
Director, Backend Engineering
Redwood Inference
